Package com.example.volt.currentposition

Class CurrentPositionManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.currentposition.CurrentPositionManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.robotemi.sdk.navigation.listener.OnCurrentPositionChangedListener
public class CurrentPositionManager extends Object implements com.robotemi.sdk.navigation.listener.OnCurrentPositionChangedListener
CurrentPositionManager updates the ImageView that represents the current position of the robot so it always shows the right position.

Representation Invariant:

  • currentPositionImageView != null

Abstraction Function:

CurrentPositionManager cpm represents a link between the Robot and the ImageView that represents the current position such that:
  • cpm.currentPositionImageView represents the current position on the screen.
